title: Most played artists
statementMd:
Total plays per artist, top 5 (ties by name).

Expected columns: `name`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Join plays to tracks to albums to artists.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ar.name, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id JOIN artists ar ON ar.id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.id, ar.name ORDER BY plays DESC, ar.name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
